svg.title: Binary search: the window halving, four rows deep
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Binary search: the window halving, four rows deep” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Four rows of the same twelve-element sorted array. In each row the eliminated half is greyed and crossed out, the midpoint is highlighted, and the invariant lo and hi plus the comparison made is written to the right, ending when the midpoint lands on 72.
svg.text: Binary search: the window halving, four rows deep
draw it from memory, then compare
